title: customer escalation war room - nova pay - 2026-03-16 (draft)
body:
War room notes — NovaPay production inference failures
Date: 2026-03-16
Owner: Maya Rodriguez (CS lead)
Status: DRAFT — running live triage, notes to be cleaned up for postmortem

Purpose:
- Capture timeline, triage findings, and immediate mitigation steps for NovaPay (customer) experiencing 5xx errors and degraded latency for hosted API route /v1/generate-chat.
- Track action items and owners for SRE, infra, and customer success comms.

Participants (joined):
- Maya Rodriguez (CS) — war-room lead
- Liam Chen (SRE) — infra & logs
- Priya Kapoor (Serving Runtime) — model/runtime expert
- Daniel Brooks (Solutions Eng) — customer-facing technical contact (NovaPay)
- Sofia Martins (On-call PM) — prioritization / SLAs
- NovaPay contact: Rajiv Patel (engineering)

Impact summary (as reported):
- Window: ~2026-03-16 09:12–ongoing
- Symptoms: Intermittent 500s from hosted API for NovaPay org; increased p95 latency from ~180ms -> 1.2s; some requests returning truncated/generated partial responses.
- Scope: NovaPay production org only (org_id=org_novapay). No broad platform outage observed (other orgs healthy).
- Severity: P1 for NovaPay (customer-reported revenue impact: payment confirmation delays).

Timeline / initial signals:
- 09:10: NovaPay CS ping to #escalations-nova-pay.
- 09:12: Auto-alert from routing service: error-rate spike for route `nova-pay-prod:/v1/generate-chat` (alerts CS-4821).
- 09:15: SRE triage — discovered increased 502/500 from model-serving workers pinned to worker-pool gpupool-d-02 (region-us-west2).
- 09:22: Priya noticed KV cache invalidations for prefix cache keys for org_novapay followed by repeated full-model activations.
- 09:28: Observed that a recent rollout (model pin -> model:open-redwood-13b-quant-v2, rollout id rr-2026-03-16-09) completed at 09:05 and coincides with symptom onset.

Immediate checks done:
- Logs (Liam): stack traces show OOM-exec on some serving containers during warmup for long-context requests (seq_len ~4096).
- Metrics (SRE): allocation pressure on gpupool-d-02 increased 4x; autoscaler didn't scale due to incorrect capacity limits on the pool (limit set to 6, desired 12).
- Routing (Priya): requests for NovaPay were being routed to a model variant with a different kv-cache encoding (quantized v2) causing cache misses and frequent recomputation of KV cache.
- Customer reproduction (Daniel): NovaPay replayed failing request; observed consistent 500 with stack trace matching OOM in runtime.cu::kv_restore.

Hypothesis:
- The rollout to open-redwood-13b-quant-v2 changed kernel memory footprint; combined with long-context requests from NovaPay and a pool capacity limit, this pushed workers into OOM/fail states and triggered 500s. KV cache encoding mismatch increased compute per request (no cache hits), exacerbating pressure.

Immediate mitigations applied (fast actions):
1) Rollback: Initiated automated rollback of rollout rr-2026-03-16-09 to previous model variant (open-redwood-13b-quant-v1) for NovaPay pinned route. Status: in-progress — expected complete 09:40. (Owner: Priya)
2) Route fix: Temporarily route NovaPay org traffic to fallback dedicated pool gpupool-d-01 that has higher headroom. (Owner: Liam)
3) Autoscaler patch: Increase gpupool-d-02 max capacity from 6 -> 16 as temporary override. (Owner: Sofia)
4) Customer comms: Daniel/Rajiv: Notify NovaPay of ongoing mitigation and ask to pause synthetic high-seq_len jobs for 30 minutes. (Owner: Daniel)

Action items (tracked):
- Priya Kapoor: finish rollback and verify model variant parity + cache encoding for NovaPay route. Due: 2026-03-16 09:45.
- Liam Chen: monitor gpupool-d-02 and gpupool-d-01 metrics (GPU memory, rx/tx, OOMs) and keep alert channel open. Post logs to Confluence page. Due: 2026-03-16 10:00.
- Sofia Martins: raise internal infra ticket to investigate autoscaler limit mis-config (JIRA: INFRA-2107). Ensure permanent fix for min/max capacity policies. Due: 2026-03-18 EOD.
- Daniel Brooks: update NovaPay on rollback and coordinate verification tests. Collect failing request sample and sanitized logs for postmortem. Due: 2026-03-16 10:15.
- Maya Rodriguez: draft customer-facing incident summary and next steps; prepare postmortem owner assignment. Due: 2026-03-17.

Notes / debugging artifacts to collect (short checklist):
- [ ] Full request/response traces (traced via X-Request-ID) for a representative failed request. (Liam)
- [ ] Worker core dumps / container logs for gpupool-d-02 during failure window. (Liam)
- [ ] Model rollout metadata (rollout id rr-2026-03-16-09) and exact kernel/compile flags used. (Priya)
- [ ] KV cache encoding spec differences between quant-v1 and quant-v2. (Priya)
- [ ] Customer-supplied payloads (sanitized) that reproduce high sequence lengths. (Daniel)

Customer verification plan:
- After rollback completes, ask NovaPay to run 3 representative production requests (seq_len up to 4096) and confirm success rate > 99% for 15 minutes. If stable, schedule a controlled canary for quant-v2 with lower concurrency.

Longer-term remediation candidates (postmortem recommendations draft):
- Add rollout preflight check: memory footprint estimation per kernel for new quantization variants and compare against pool headroom.
- Expand autoscaler policy to consider model-specific memory profiles, not just historical utilization.
- Improve cache-compatibility guarantees in rollout metadata (explicit encoding/version header) and automatic migration path.
- Add regression test: synthetic long-context workload run in staging for any quantized model variant.

Communications plan:
- Internal: update #incidents and #sre-oncall during major milestones (rollback complete, verification done).
- Customer: Daniel to post short status update to Rajiv every 15 mins until verification passes. Then send incident summary and postmortem link within 48 hours.

Open questions / things to confirm:
- Did any other org see increased latency but not yet reported? quick org-scan (Liam).
- Why did autoscaler respect the old max=6 limit? Was it from a stale config pushed during 2026-03-10 infra deploy? (Sofia + Infra)
- Are kernel selection heuristics updated for quant-v2? (Priya to confirm with runtime team)

Notes to self (Maya):
- When drafting postmortem, call out sequence_len distribution and customer workload shape — helps justify model-specific autoscaling.
- Keep the customer-facing language focused on: what we did, why it happened, what we will do to prevent recurrence. Avoid low-level kernel talk in the initial customer note.

Post-war-room quick log (09:50):
- Rollback rr-2026-03-16-09 completed at 09:39; routing back to quant-v1 in progress; initial customer verification: 8/8 requests succeeded, p95 latency ~190ms.
- Continued monitoring for 30m.

Next steps after monitoring window:
- Convene postmortem working group (SRE + runtime + CS + infra) — target: 2026-03-18 11:00. (Owner: Maya)
- Draft incident summary for NovaPay and internal postmortem doc. (Owner: Maya)

TODO (follow-up):
- [ ] Attach sanitized request payloads and error traces to this doc.
- [ ] Link INFRA-2107 and CS-4821 when created/updated.
- [ ] Run controlled canary for quant-v2 with reduced concurrency and mem-profiling.

End of notes — will clean up and publish final postmortem after verification window and artifact collection.
